pages.text: Press $(l)R$() to switch between $(l)battle stance$() and mining stance. Fight in battle stance; mine and build in mining stance.$(br2)In battle stance: $(l)left-click$() attacks in combos, $(l)Left Alt$() dodges, $(l)right-click$() guards, $(l)G$() locks on, and $(l)K$() opens your skills. Dodges, guards and weapon skills cost $(l)stamina$(): watch the bar.
